svg.title: .SYSTEMX — combined system atlas
svg.desc: A true visual composite of four current system map panels and seven current agent guide panels. Open each full-size SVG and the text companion for readable details.
svg.text: ONE SYSTEM / FOUR MAPS / SEVEN AGENTS
Zoom into the full-size panels for paths, commands and boundaries
SELECT SCOPE → READ TASK → ROUTE WORK → REVIEW EVIDENCE → OWNER ACCEPTS
The atlas is navigation; no role, workbook row or provider label grants access.
